description: Open an invitation a business sent the user, using the invitation code from their message (8 letters and digits, e.g. K7Q2M8XD). Returns the business, what the invitation is about, its contact person and its current public documents with download links. Works before the user signs in. Documents shared only with the invited address open after that address confirms the invitation (the claim link in the result) and signs in.
name: open_invitation
title: Open an invitation
